method.feeAndServiceStandard: DETERMINATION_FEE_AND_WAIVER_STANDARD.json was read before FEE_AND_WAIVER or SERVICE was scored on any family, and its amendment A1 test was applied first on every one: ask whether the repository establishes the answer, and only where it does not may a named checkable authority stand in. The authority for what the repository holds was taken to be the committed packet-set manifest entry for the family's own packetSetId, plus its legal-design intake memo and its own local-filing records.

verdicts.whatTheRepairFixed: The five instruction-level obligations the earlier read failed were rewritten and four now hold — REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER and SELF_HELP_STOP all pass on a fresh read of the current text.
whyItStillFails: COMPONENT_SET — the canonical completeness gate refuses this family before it counts anything. verify-packet-completeness.mjs returns FAIL_COMPONENT_SET at 0/0 written with auditable:false, because readFieldRows() recognises none of the four schemas it reads: this family's documents carry writeBoxes / withheldBeforeTheFactory / roleRefusals instead of fields / writableAnchors / withheld / maps, so `shape` stays null and the verifier early-returns at line 179. No component is actually missing — all three roles the packet-set manifest declares are present by direct read — so the repair is the field map's schema, not the packet. The Ohio host solved the identical refusal by adopting the documents-and-decisions shape in commit 3b44dcbec.

SERVICE — the committed packet-set manifest for this packetSetId holds 'Serve the prosecuting attorney within three days of filing. The prosecuting attorney has 30 days to object.' Neither the three-day deadline nor the 30-day objection window appears anywhere in the family directory, and participant-instructions.md states the opposite conclusion: 'The form sets no separate service deadline.' That is true about the form and false about the repository. The recipients and the methods are correct and need no repair; only the timing is missing.
verdicts.whyCountersNotMeasured: The verifier's early return means the nine zeros it prints are initialisation values, not measurements. They are recorded as null in the row rather than zero so no reader mistakes a refusal for a clean count. The obligations that would have depended on them were measured instead by direct read of the field map and the participant blanks report: 8 write boxes, 22 withheld blanks, 41 disclosed blanks, 0 blanks lacking a reason, 0 blanks lacking a refusal class, 0 selection controls, 0 glyphs outside a measured blank.

verdicts.note: All fifteen pass and all nine counters are zero, measured here. A composed family with no binary to bind; SOURCE_IDENTITY was scored by verifying that the two codified grounds the receipt names are present and say what it says they say. FEE_AND_WAIVER and SERVICE both pass on the named-authority limb, and the repository genuinely establishes neither — the manifest records no fee identified for the prosecutor application and no service rule, because the mechanism has no adverse party at the participant's stage.

verdicts.whyNotTheStrongestVerdict: Zero obligations failed and zero went unmeasured, so the fifteen would carry PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT. It is held at PASS for one reason that is not a defect in the packet: the central raster workflow has never run on this family, because RASTER_QUEUE.json lists it notEligible for 'no fixtures directory'. Every other PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT row in these two lanes is bound to a RASTER_PASS receipt, and awarding the strongest verdict without one would make this row mean something different from its neighbours. CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP was measured instead by reading the committed full-resolution boundary rasters directly.
verdicts.repairVerified: The FIX02 repair's two claims were re-measured rather than accepted: 34 of 35 declared artifacts recompute to their declared hash here with 0 mismatches, and the completeness verifier now returns PASS_COMPLETE at 24/52 written with all nine counters zero, where it previously refused the family at 0/0.

verdicts.whatTheRepairFixed: KNOWN_PREFILLS and REPEATING_ROWS, the two obligations the earlier read failed. Both now hold: PASS_COMPLETE at 14/129 written, all nine counters zero, and coverage.unmapped 0 across 131 terminal fields on four XFA forms.
verdicts.whyItStillFails: One sentence in participant-instructions.md declares four things unestablished, and the repository establishes three of them for this exact packetSetId. The sentence is: 'The filing fee and whether it can be waived, who must be served and by what method, and the address of the court are not established in this repository. Ask the clerk of the Superior Court in the county of the arrest.' The manifest holds the service rule in full (serve the prosecuting attorney of the city or county of arrest, and the arresting agency, at least 15 days before the hearing), the filing rule in full (a two-branch venue rule, a 15-day deadline, one arrest per petition), and the waiver answer (FW-001). The strings 'FW-001', '15 days' and 'prosecuting attorney' appear nowhere in the family directory. Only the fee amount is genuinely open, and the manifest says so in the same terms the packet does — 'Unresolved and county-specific. Do not publish a figure.'
verdicts.aggravatingFact: The packet ships and fully maps CR-106, the Judicial Council's own Proof of Service for criminal record clearing, while telling the participant the repository does not know who must be served. The participant has the instrument for proving service, has been told the parties are unknown, and has a 15-day deadline nobody mentioned.
verdicts.repairIsNarrow: All three failures live in one paragraph of one file. No artifact byte moves, no field map changes, no source is refetched, and the nine counters stay zero. The repair is to state what the packet-set manifest already holds and keep the honest 'ask the clerk' for the fee amount alone.
verdicts.howItReversed: This is a reversal in the direction the determination anticipated but on the amendment rather than the main rule. The earlier read predates DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001; amendment A1's test — ask first whether the repository establishes the answer — is what turns these three from acceptable referrals into failures.

verdicts.note: All fifteen pass and all nine counters are zero, measured here. The strongest FEE_AND_WAIVER answer available: the packet states that no fee is charged and cites C.G.S. § 54-142a(k) for it, which is the determination's first met limb, and the manifest agrees exactly. The family is also unusually disciplined about what it does not build — it composes no filable instrument at all, asserts the absence of any signature line or caption from the output bytes on every build, and pins the § 54-142a(c)(2) motion branch as unavailable so that opening it forces a deliberate rebuild.

verdicts.note: The FIX03 repair answered all three with sources rather than with the named-authority fallback the determination would have allowed. It located the Vermont Judiciary's own filing-instruction form 200-00130A in the held corpus and quoted its fee rule and its service rule verbatim, so this family carries an actual sourced amount — no fee to seal or expunge except a $90 fee for 23 V.S.A. § 1201(a) convictions, with the waiver form 600-00228 shipped as component 3 of the packet — and an actual sourced service rule, that the court provides the copy to the prosecutor rather than the participant. I verified both quotations against the source bytes in this container: the form is in the corpus at the SHA-256 the packet cites, and both sentences are in it word for word. This is the strongest of the six.

forTheCaptainToDecide.severity: blocks two families from the strongest verdict
forTheCaptainToDecide.finding: RASTER_QUEUE.json cannot see the fixtures of two families that have them. rcap-oh-custom-pleading-clean-tracks is listed notEligible for 'no fixtures directory' while holding eight fixture PDFs at tracks/<trackId>/rendered/<fixture>/<fixture>.pdf; ca-851-91-set is listed notEligible for 'no canonical PDF' and 'no boundary PDF' while holding sixteen at fixtures/<variant>/<form>.pdf. The queue generator looks for fixtures/canonical.pdf and fixtures/boundary.pdf. Both families have rendered, hash-stable fixtures and local rasters, and neither has ever reached the central visual gate.
forTheCaptainToDecide.consequence: Lane contract L4 refuses to prove a family without a hash-bound RASTER_PASS from the central workflow, so neither family can be promoted no matter how it verifies. The Ohio family is otherwise clean on all fifteen obligations.
forTheCaptainToDecide.decision: Whether to teach the raster-queue generator to find multi-document and per-variant fixture layouts. This is a queue-generator change, not a packet repair, and it is outside a verifier's hands.

forTheCaptainToDecide.severity: a shared-contract question with two families already blocked on it
forTheCaptainToDecide.finding: The completeness contract's readFieldRows() reads four field-map schemas and refuses anything else as unauditable. ar-misdemeanor-dwi-seal-set emits a fifth shape — documents[] carrying writeBoxes, withheldBeforeTheFactory, roleRefusals, refusedByTheFactory and protectedRulesHandedToTheFactory — and is refused at 0/0 written. The Ohio family hit the same refusal from the other direction (no field map at all) and its FIX02 repair solved it by adopting the contract's documents-and-decisions shape.
forTheCaptainToDecide.consequence: The Arkansas family cannot show completeness by the gate that defines it, even though every component the manifest declares is present.
forTheCaptainToDecide.decision: Whether the Arkansas host should be repaired to emit a schema the contract reads — the narrow fix, inside the family's owned path — or whether readFieldRows() should learn the writeBoxes shape, which is a shared-contract change touching every family that uses it. The Arkansas build-findings.json already flags a related shared-module gap it declined to patch for the same reason.
forTheCaptainToDecide.recommendation: The narrow fix, on the Ohio precedent. A verifier should not be the one to widen a shared contract.

forTheCaptainToDecide.severity: informational, but it changes what a queue row means
forTheCaptainToDecide.finding: MASTER_QUEUE.json records ar-misdemeanor-dwi-seal-set as SOURCE_IDENTITY_NOT_EXACT with sourceBound false and the reason 'MISSING_DOCUMENT — no held corpus entry for this form number and no exact custody binding'. That is wrong against the bytes. Both ACIC forms are in the mounted corpus and both recompute to the receipt's exact pinned SHA-256 and byte length. The queue resolves by form number against a committed index, and these two files are indexed under their ACIC document ids in STATES/AR/05_SOURCE_GATED rather than under a form number, so the lookup misses documents the corpus holds.
forTheCaptainToDecide.consequence: Left alone, this sends the source conveyor after two files the repository already has, and it understates the family's real source posture.
forTheCaptainToDecide.decision: Whether the same form-number lookup is hiding held sources for other families in 05_SOURCE_GATED. I checked only this one.

forTheCaptainToDecide.severity: a boundary question the determination may want to settle
forTheCaptainToDecide.finding: Two of my six failures — ar-misdemeanor-dwi-seal-set SERVICE and all three ca-851-91-set failures — turn on treating the committed packet-set manifest's participantActionRequired entries as a held source that establishes the answer for amendment A1's test. A1 settled that the track registry counts as such a source for FILING_DESTINATION. I have read the packet-set manifest the same way, for FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER and SERVICE alike, because it is committed, keyed to the family's own packetSetId, and states rules in operative terms.
forTheCaptainToDecide.consequence: If the Captain agrees, both failures stand and the California repair is a short, well-specified instruction edit. If the manifest is not a held source for this purpose, the California family passes fifteen of fifteen and the Arkansas SERVICE failure falls away, leaving Arkansas failing on COMPONENT_SET alone.
forTheCaptainToDecide.decision: Confirm or narrow the class of records that count as 'the repository establishing the answer'. I have flagged this rather than assuming it settled, which is what the verifier who raised A1 did.
forTheCaptainToDecide.myReading: The manifest should count. A1's reasoning is that naming an authority is what honesty requires when the record is empty and is not a way to avoid stating what the record contains, and the record here is not empty — it holds a 15-day service deadline and two named recipients.

forTheCaptainToDecide.severity: advisory, no verdict turns on it
forTheCaptainToDecide.finding: Three smaller things a repairer or Captain may want, none of which I scored as a failure: (a) each per-track Ohio packet-set manifest declares hearing_and_objection_instructions as a required component and the family ships no content for it, so a participant is never told when the prosecutor may object or that a hearing may be set; (b) Ohio's rendered-artifacts.json and companion-guidance.md both name a companion BCI PDF path that holds nothing — the bytes check out against the corpus and the exclusion was disclosed in the C11 and FIX02 commits, but a reader without the corpus cannot verify that one row; (c) vt_seal_felony-set has the thinnest SELF_HELP_STOP of the six, with no stop-condition list and no flag on the § 7602 waiting periods or offence exclusions, and it shares a build host with four sibling Vermont families, so strengthening it is one change reaching five packets.

grantsNothing: This return records six readings. It promotes no family, opens no commercial route, creates no fulfilment record, grants no approval, marks no packet proven and changes no route's availability. The two PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT verdicts and the one PASS are statements about proof obligations, not about commercial readiness; rcap-oh-custom-pleading-clean-tracks in particular declares on its own face that its drafts are review artifacts and not filing-ready, and that remains true whatever this row says.
